Profile-likelihood intervals of DAMOCLES parameters

Source: R/damocles_regimes.R
confint.mc_damocles_fit.Rd

Confidence intervals for the parameters of damocles_fit() from the profile likelihood: the interval holds the values at which the log-likelihood, maximised over the other parameters, is within \(\chi^2_1(\mathrm{level}) / 2\) of its maximum, half the level quantile of a chi-squared distribution with one degree of freedom. With shared parameters there is one interval per parameter; otherwise one per community. A bound the profile does not reach within a factor of \(e^{10}\) of the estimate (rates), 10 units (slopes beta) or 10 units on the logit scale (sympatry) is reported as the edge of the parameter space (0 or Inf for rates, -Inf or Inf for slopes, 0 or 1 for sympatry): the data do not bound it.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mc_damocles_fit'
confint(object, parm = NULL, level = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

object

A fit of class mc_damocles_fit.

parm

Names of the parameters, among the columns of the fit; by default all free parameters.

level

Confidence level.

...

Not used.

Value

A data frame with the community ("shared" for shared parameters), the parameter, its estimate and the lower and upper bounds.

See also

damocles_fit().

Other dynamic null model: clade_regimes(), damocles_loglik(), damocles_lrt(), damocles_test(), simulate_damocles()

Examples

set.seed(6)
tr <- treeshapesim::sim_tree_shape(40)
comm <- simulate_damocles(tr, gamma = 1, mu = 1, n = 10)
fit <- damocles_fit(comm, tr, shared = TRUE)
confint(fit)
#>   community parameter     estimate     lower     upper
#> 1    shared     gamma 6.814352e-01 0.5287597 0.8632444
#> 2    shared        mu 2.344120e-09 0.0000000       Inf
